findings_qualitative.value: Propanal forms from C2H2 + CO + H co-deposition at 10 K and hydrogenation of propanal yields 1-propanol

evidence.quote: We show that the hydrogenation of propanal ice leads to 1-propanol formation.

claims.hypothesis: 1-propanol can form via propanal hydrogenation and radical recombination in CO + C2H2 + H ices
claims.experiment: TPD-QMS and RAIRS of ice experiments at 10 K
claims.result: Propanal detected in C2H2+CO+H; 1-propanol clearly formed from propanal + H, only tentative from C2H2+CO+H
claims.finding: HCO + H2CCH / H3CCH2 most likely route

evidence.quote: We find the formation of propanal and possibly 1-propanol ice.

claims.hypothesis: 1-propanol:propanal ratio in IRAS 16293-2422B is consistent with a barrier on propanal hydrogenation
claims.experiment: LTE upper limit on 1-propanol from ALMA spectra compared to literature propanal

evidence.quote: This is consistent with the experiments in this work and also with the theoretical calculations by (cite: zaverkin2018tunnelling)

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Radical–molecule reactions and propynal routes excluded due to high barriers

evidence.quote: Radical–molecule reactions, such as those between the HCO radical and C$_2$H$_2$ or C$_2$H$_4$ molecules, can also be excluded due to their high activation barriers.

limitations_admitted.value: 1-propanol detection from C2H2+CO+H is just at the detection limit

evidence.quote: the detection of 1-propanol starting from a propanal-poor sample is just around the limit of our detection capabilities.
